title: Junior Business Data Analyst
description:
PIX4D is seeking a talented Business Data Analyst to bridge Finance, Product Management and Commercial Operations (Sales and Marketing), develop complex analytical tools to drive strategic decisions and optimize processes. You will be a member of PIX4D’s dynamic Finance team, in a hybrid work environment, based in Lausanne, Switzerland.

In this cross-functional role, you will query complex datasets, build dashboards, define KPIs, and translate emerging trends into actionable insights for stakeholders. You will balance data integrity with commercial impact, transforming raw data into insights that support high-level strategic decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Cleaning, manipulating, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
  • Dashboard Development: Creating interactive dashboards and reports using dashboarding tools and leveraging AI-powered tools for enhanced automation and visualization.
  • AI & Automation: Leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to streamline data workflows and enhance intelligent decision-making.
  • Database Querying: Using SQL to extract and prepare data from various systems.
  • Actionable Insights: Translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for business growth, efficiency, and optimization.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Working with cross-functional teams to define business requirements and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Data Governance: Ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and standardization.

Requirements

  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Excel (advanced), and experience using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
  • AI Proficiency: Familiarity with Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations.
  • Analytical Abilities: Strong statistical knowledge, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
  • Communication: Ability to tell a story with data to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Education/Experience: A master’s degree in business, economics, statistics, or data analytics, coupled with a first experience in supporting data-driven decisions.

What we offer

  • Exciting work with cutting-edge technology in an international company.
  • Well-located office near Lausanne, with easy access by public transport.
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work possibility.
  • 25 days of paid vacation.
  • Employee Assistance Program with Lyra providing Mental, Legal and Financial assistance.
  • Contribution to some events: Bike to Work (the biggest health and cycling promotion campaign in Switzerland), Lausanne Triathlon.
  • Discounts for local stores, restaurants and other services.
  • Company Social Events.
  • Learning and professional development opportunities.

Working environment

PIX4D is a unique, fun, and intellectually stimulating company where you can grow and excel in your field. Our environment is authentic and multicultural, a place where we respect and learn from each other in the pursuit of being the best at what we do. Get more information here.

Recruitment

PIX4D promotes diversity and offers opportunities across all levels and career paths in all of its offices regardless of gender, race, or religion. We use standardized and structured interviews to ensure all candidates are treated equally and avoid any discrimination.

Company
When you work at PIX4D, you empower professionals worldwide to digitize reality through survey-grade georeferenced 2D maps and 3D models. These outputs can be measured, analyzed, and shared, all based on data from images taken by plane, drone, or mobile phone.

We build solutions that take advantage of technology including reality capture, computer vision, digital twins, and machine learning to help solve our customers' most complex challenges.

Founded in 2011, PIX4D has its headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland and commercial and R&D offices in Denver, Berlin, Tokyo, Bucharest and Madrid.

Additional information

All our candidate applications are screened by humans and not an AI recruiter.

title: Product Data Analyst
CRM & Marketing Operations Associate
description:
CRM & Marketing Operations Associate

Elliptic has been tracking down crypto crime since 2013, trusted by banks, businesses, and governments worldwide to keep the financial system safe. Today, our compliance tools cover the large majority of global crypto exchange volume, and a $120m Series D is fuelling the next stage of that work.

You'll keep HubSpot, our go-to-market system of record, accurate and well run, so a world-class marketing team can move fast on numbers the business trusts. Reporting to our Head of CRM, you'll get a front-row seat to how an entire marketing and revenue function works, from first lead to renewal.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on, day-to-day HubSpot experience across forms, email, workflows, segments, custom objects and reporting

  • A solid understanding of B2B marketing channels and how they connect to the CRM and the wider marketing technology stack

  • An eye for process and detail: you spot the clunky step and can't leave it alone

  • Clear communication and documentation, with the ability to turn business requirements into clear recommendations

  • Fluency with AI tools as part of your daily workflow, you use them to move faster and think better, and you know when not to trust them

Bonus points for marketing operations experience in B2B SaaS, hands-on time with tools like Dreamdata, Zapier, Intercom or Notion, or a basic understanding of how APIs move data between systems.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain CRM audience segmentation, and handle segment requests from marketing and commercial teams

  • Own data quality, forms, subscription types and email templates, so records stay accurate and compliant across the customer lifecycle

  • Build our lead source tracking, UTM standards and attribution reporting across HubSpot and Dreamdata

  • Monitor email health and deliverability, and build the dashboards and Notion documentation that marketing and leadership rely on

What we offer you

How we work

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 remote working budget to set up your home office space

Learning & Development

  • $1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

Leave

  • Holidays: 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks of fully-paid leave

Benefits

  • Private health insurance: we use Bupa!

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

  • Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this, but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

We hire for trajectory as much as track record. If this sounds like you, apply even if you don't tick every box, we'd genuinely rather meet you than miss you.

title: CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a curious, commercially sharp CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps function. This is a dual-natured role: on one side, hands-on CRM administration and data stewardship within a collaborative team; on the other, a broader remit that spans the full commercial journey — from Marketing through Sales to Customer Success — ensuring the processes, tools, and data that connect them are coherent, reliable, and built to support business growth.

You'll work closely with our Revenue Operations Manager, based in Copenhagen, and collaborate with market teams, sales and marketing stakeholders, and internal IT across all 14 markets. This isn't a role for someone who wants to execute instructions in isolation. We want someone who understands the commercial context behind what they're building — and who takes ownership of making sure it actually works for the people using it.

What You'll Do

CRM Administration & Development

– Support the maintenance and ongoing development of our HubSpot CRM in collaboration with the RevOps team — covering data quality, property management, workflow logic, and pipeline integrity across all markets

– Assist in building, testing, and documenting automation workflows, lifecycle stages, and custom data structures

– Act as a reliable point of contact for CRM-related queries from market teams, escalating where needed and closing the loop on issues

Reporting & Market Intelligence

– Build and maintain dashboards and reports in HubSpot to support sales leadership and country managers across all 14 markets

– Translate reporting requests into structured, actionable outputs — not just visualisations, but insights that inform decisions

– Monitor data health proactively and flag inconsistencies before they compound

Revenue Operations — Marketing to Customer Success

– Support the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of processes that span the full commercial funnel — from marketing acquisition through sales pipeline management to customer success handoffs

– Help ensure that tools, data flows, and operational logic work coherently across functions, reducing friction and improving visibility at every stage

– Contribute to ICP qualification frameworks, segmentation models, lead management logic, and pipeline hygiene practices

– Collaborate with internal IT to support integrations between internal systems and the broader commercial toolstack, helping bridge technical and business requirements

Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration

– Work alongside sales, marketing, customer success, and IT stakeholders to understand needs, gather requirements, and translate them into operational solutions

– Communicate clearly across functions and markets — managing expectations, flagging dependencies, and keeping the right people informed

– Represent the RevOps function as a reliable, solutions-oriented partner rather than a bottleneck

Training Materials & Process Documentation

– Develop clear, structured training materials covering tools, processes, and operational frameworks — ensuring teams across all markets have what they need to work effectively

– Maintain process and system documentation as a living resource, updated as workflows evolve

– Work across our training infrastructure (including Supered and Sana) to publish and distribute materials to the right audiences

– Identify knowledge gaps through stakeholder engagement and translate them into practical, usable guidance

What We're Looking For

– 1–2 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, CRM administration, or a closely adjacent role

– Solid working knowledge of CRM systems — HubSpot experience is a significant advantage and will be strongly prioritised

– Analytically capable, with the ability to turn raw data into clear, usable business insights

– Sharp commercial instinct — you understand how operational decisions connect to revenue outcomes across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

– Comfortable working cross-functionally, including with technical stakeholders such as IT, and translating between business needs and system capabilities

– Detail-oriented and process-driven, without losing sight of the bigger picture

– Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a genuine bonus — Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, French, Dutch, Portuguese, or Polish

– Proactively curious — you ask questions before you build, and you build things that last

Nice to Have

– Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond basic CRM use — workflows, reporting, custom properties, or integrations

– Familiarity with sales intelligence tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Evergrowth

– Experience supporting tool integrations or working alongside IT on system connectivity

– Exposure to multi-market or international business environments

– A track record of creating structured training content or process documentation

– Background in B2B services, IT staffing, or professional consultancy

What We Offer

– A central role in emagine's revenue infrastructure, with genuine cross-market scope from day one

– Direct mentorship from an experienced Revenue Operations Manager with deep HubSpot and systems expertise

– Broad exposure to a modern RevOps toolstack and clear room to grow — technically and strategically

– A hybrid working setup with real autonomy and flexibility, based in one of our office locations across our 14 markets

– The opportunity to grow alongside a function that is actively expanding its influence across the business

We empower companies with high-end IT services

emagine is a high-end business, engineering & IT consulting company. Enabled by an extensive network of experts, emagine powers progress, solves challenges and delivers real results through tailored high-end consulting services. emagine is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with departments in France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates as well as India. Over the last couple of years, the company has grown extensively, increasing its international footprint to become one of the biggest consultancies in its segment in Europe and beyond. emagine A/S is owned by private equity company Axcel and a group of senior staff and board members.

Are you our new colleague?

At emagine, we value diversity immensely. Both when it comes to backgrounds and competences, but also in relation to personality and individual ambition. We are a diverse and well-rounded group made up of experienced specialists, generalists, recent graduates and self-taught people. We are generally curious, helpful and happy to share knowledge with our colleagues.

We are proud of our values that are based on honesty, kindness, helpfulness and solidarity. We nurture a strong community culture, where cooperation is paramount – not just locally but also across borders with our international departments. Only in unison can we provide the best service to our clients and affiliated consultants – and that is our goal. As an employee of emagine, you will experience a close-knit culture in which people stand side by side and where there is an emphasis on building close relationships. Going to work must be a fun and enriching experience yet still provide a challenge. That is why we take several steps to ensure that work is motivating and engaging. Finally, we also strive to create the right conditions for physical and mental wellbeing.

Want to know more about what it is like to work at emagine?

Visit our Instagram to get a better idea of who we are or get in contact with our HR department.
